extras: Permanent deletion cannot be undone through Obsidian, so keep backups or sync history enabled.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a direct way to empty that folder at once, without deleting files one by one.
problem: Obsidian moves deleted files to a hidden .trash folder, requiring users to delete items one by one.
summary: A utility that permanently removes all files and folders from the vault's local .trash folder with a single click.
